title: On-Call Rotation Planner
description: Plan a fair round-robin on-call rotation: enter the team, pick a start date and number of weeks, get the full schedule with per-person totals and CSV export.
howto: Type one team member per line.
Pick the rotation start date, weeks per turn and total weeks.
Press Generate for the round-robin schedule with exact date ranges.
Download the CSV or copy the schedule to share with the team.

faqs.a: Strict round-robin: member 1 takes the first turn, member 2 the second, and so on, wrapping back to member 1. Everyone gets equal turns over a full cycle.

faqs.q: What if the weeks don't divide evenly?
faqs.a: The schedule simply continues the rotation — the totals row shows exactly how many weeks each person covers, so any imbalance is visible.
The planner assigns continuous turns. For holiday overrides, generate the CSV, then adjust the affected rows in a spreadsheet.
